title: Craig Silvey jailed over 'most depraved' child exploitation material
paragraphs: Disgraced author Craig Silvey has been jailed for seven months for possessing and distributing child exploitation material.
Silvey was on an adult pornography website when he connected with another user and later began sharing explicit videos and images.
Judge Hayley Cormann said the material Silvey had possessed and his communications about it were "repulsive" and "degrading".
